5	- Node.js 18+ (with npm)
6	- A terminal/command line
7	
8	## Installation Steps
9	
10	1. **Install dependencies:**
11	   ```bash
12	   npm install
13	   ```
14	
15	   This will install:
16	   - `typescript` - TypeScript compiler
17	   - `marked` - Markdown to HTML parser
18	   - `gray-matter` - Frontmatter YAML parser
19	   - `jest` - Testing framework
20	   - `ts-jest` - TypeScript support for Jest
21	
22	2. **Build the project:**
23	   ```bash
24	   npm run build
25	   ```
26	
27	   This compiles TypeScript files from `src/` to JavaScript in `dist/`.
28	
29	## Running Tests
30	
31	Execute all tests:
32	```bash
33	npm test
34	```
35	
36	This runs Jest and executes:
37	- **Parser tests** - Verify markdown parsing and frontmatter extraction
38	- **Generator tests** - Verify HTML generation and escaping
39	- **Integration tests** - Verify CLI functionality
40	
41	## Using the CLI
42	
43	### Option 1: Using default directories
44	
45	```bash
46	# Creates content in ./content and output to ./dist
47	npx ssg build
48	```
49	
50	### Option 2: Custom directories
51	
52	```bash
53	# Custom input and output directories
54	npx ssg build --content ./my-posts --output ./my-site
55	
56	# Only custom content directory
57	npx ssg build --content ./posts
58	
59	# Only custom output directory
60	npx ssg build --output ./website
61	```
62	
63	## Project Structure
64	
65	```
66	.
67	├── src/
68	│   ├── cli.ts                 # CLI entry point and argument parsing
69	│   ├── parser.ts              # Markdown parser with gray-matter
70	│   ├── generator.ts           # HTML generation functions
71	│   └── __tests__/
72	│       ├── parser.test.ts     # Parser unit tests
73	│       ├── generator.test.ts  # Generator unit tests
74	│       └── cli.test.ts        # Integration tests
75	├── dist/                       # Compiled JavaScript (generated)
76	├── content/                    # Sample markdown files
77	├── package.json               # Project configuration
78	├── tsconfig.json              # TypeScript configuration
79	├── jest.config.js             # Jest configuration
80	└── README.md                  # Main documentation
81	```
82	
83	## Example Workflow
84	
85	1. **Create content directory:**
86	   ```bash
87	   mkdir my-content
88	   ```
89	
90	2. **Add markdown files:**
91	   ```bash
92	   cat > my-content/hello.md << 'EOF'
93	   ---
94	   title: Hello World
95	   date: 2024-01-15
96	   tags:
97	     - hello
98	   ---
99	
100	   # Hello World
101	
102	   This is my first post!
103	   EOF
104	   ```
105	
106	3. **Build the site:**
107	   ```bash
108	   npm run build
109	   npx ssg build --content my-content --output my-output
110	   ```
111	
112	4. **Check results:**
113	   ```bash
114	   ls my-output/
115	   # Output: hello.html  index.html
116	   ```
117	
118	5. **View in browser:**
119	   Open `my-output/index.html` in your browser to see the site.

141	## Troubleshooting
142	
143	### "ssg: command not found"
144	Make sure you've built the project:
145	```bash
146	npm run build
147	```
148	
149	### "Content directory not found"
150	The specified content directory doesn't exist. Create it:
151	```bash
152	mkdir -p ./your-content-dir
153	```
154	
155	### Markdown not rendering
156	Ensure your markdown files have `.md` extension and are in the correct directory.
157	
158	### Test failures
159	1. Clear node_modules and rebuild:
160	   ```bash
161	   rm -rf node_modules
162	   npm install
163	   npm run build
164	   npm test
165	   ```

167	## Development Mode
168	
169	For continuous compilation during development:
170	```bash
171	npm run dev
172	```
173	
174	This starts TypeScript compiler in watch mode.
